title: Universal Media Decomposer architecture options analysis
body: Reviewed Task.md, upstream technology research, and complete T1-T8 adversarial log. Greenfield repository has no prior ADRs or implementation constraints. Surviving architecture is a single Postgres semantic ledger with versioned/upcastable events, shared Tier-0/Tier-1 reducer, single-writer rebuildable projections, OCFL immutable blobs, stable versioned locators, Hatchet primary with handler-level DB dedup, and Neo4j/RDF as disposable projections only. Key residuals to preserve: pyannote weights license, best-effort Whisper hallucination filtering, sandbox platform profile/caps, splink/DuckDB build benchmark, Hatchet exact pin, FFmpeg CVE watch, split-time reference enumeration, and OCFL local spooling. Preparing durable options report with A lead and B/C/D alternatives, scored tradeoffs, ownership map, interfaces/repository shape, rejected authorities, and requirement coverage.

title: UMD CI repair architecture stage completed
body: Completed Architect stage from the completed T1-T8 adversarial artifact, Support-Librarian promising-black-lemming, Support-Researcher critical-magenta-jackal, Task.md, parent DD, CI-repair DD, CONTRACTS, and Plans G/H/I/J. The architecture aligns with the user-selected A-refined commit-and-wire/fail-closed/prove-first direction: full Hatchet split topology as the release surface, C manifest preflight folded in as tripwire, B split-job CI only post-green complement, Lite rejected. Product and CI streams are separated in scope and ownership, with atomic gate-safe landing boundaries. Key unresolved hosted arbiters: SDK 1.38.1/server v0.105.2 compatibility; v0.105.2 env/token/config surface; handler/submission/name/host_port behavior; cold-start and probe behavior. Added a design correction to persist queued stage states (or equivalent explicit async status contract) because current ProductionDAGRunner submission leaves zero stage rows and JobService refresh can regress RUNNING to PENDING. No production code, DD, or plans edited; durable report follows in artifacts/designs/process.

title: UMD architecture status reconciliation observation
body: The architecture must explicitly address the queued-state gap: ProductionDAGRunner currently submits queued stage events without local stage-state rows, while JobService refresh can regress RUNNING to PENDING before callbacks. Prefer durable queued stage rows or an equivalent explicit asynchronous status contract; never fabricate COMPLETE.
